created_purpose: Transform timeless human principles into original audiovisual experiences that maximize the probability of meaningful reflection, emotional connection, and positive personal growth -- an Intelligent Creative Operating System, not a video-clip generator.

superseded_versions.created_purpose: Generate music videos whose visuals demonstrably teach one stated causal claim, via a structured intent-card and shot-list pipeline.
superseded_versions.superseded_reason: v1's stage-6 comprehension test checked for one compelled, intended reading; v2's mission explicitly rejects enforcing viewer belief in favor of maximizing probability of reflection.

mission_principle: DreamMusicForge exists to transform timeless human principles into original audiovisual experiences that help people see themselves, imagine new possibilities, and carry meaningful insights beyond the final frame.

provider_layer.principle: provider-neutral abstract production spec, translated per-provider at the last step

active_prototypes.name: principle_kernel_schema
active_prototypes.note: Validator rejects any kernel whose non_goals list drops the required ethics constraint against compelling viewer belief.

active_prototypes.name: narrative_emotional_architecture_schema
active_prototypes.note: Validator enforces all 8 narrative stages present, before/after states differ, waveform has >=3 monotonically-ordered beats, and every narrative stage is covered by at least one waveform beat.

active_prototypes.name: musical_architecture_schema
active_prototypes.note: First cross-document check in this repo: validate_against_narrative_architecture() confirms every tempo_map[].linked_waveform_beat_id exists in the paired Narrative + Emotional Architecture's emotional_waveform, in addition to internal tempo/dynamics/motif/silence-reference checks.

active_prototypes.name: cinematic_architecture_schema
active_prototypes.note: Composition rules (focal point, rule of thirds, golden triangle, centered framing + rationale, leading lines, headroom/leadroom, depth layering, focus technique, color/contrast) sourced from a cited practitioner composition breakdown. Cross-checks against both prior documents, including a stage-drift check (a shot's declared narrative stage must match its linked waveform beat's actual stage in the narrative document), not just referential existence.

active_prototypes.name: editorial_architecture_schema
active_prototypes.note: Last engine before the Provider-Specific Production Package. Enforces motifs that actually evolve (>=2 entries, starts introduced, ends transformed/resolved), callback payoff-after-setup ordering, and an ending-type discipline requiring explicit_statement_rationale for resolution_stated endings. Cross-checks full shot coverage against Cinematic Architecture and tempo-segment references against Musical Architecture. Completes the first full 5-document chain: Principle Kernel -> Narrative/Emotional -> Musical -> Cinematic -> Editorial.

active_prototypes.name: universal_production_blueprint_schema
active_prototypes.evidence: 20/20 smoke tests passing via `python3 dreammusicforge/tests/test_universal_production_blueprint.py`, including validate_full_chain() re-running all 9 prior validators clean on the worked example
active_prototypes.note: Assembles all five prior documents into three explicitly separated tiers (VERIFIED_STRUCTURED embedded_documents, DESIGNED_FREE_TEXT narrative_supplement, tier-3 provider_specific_prompt_sets) plus an 8-council review_checklist, so the blueprint cannot silently present unbuilt or unverified sections as equivalent to the validated ones. validate_full_chain() is the closest thing this repo has to a full pipeline integration test. Tier 3 is actually wired: embed_provider_specific_production_package() validates a real Provider-Specific Production Package and promotes build_status to 'draft' via compute_readiness_activation(), a single sigmoid neuron over two Monte Carlo risk features (weighted sum + bias, per the classic neural-network formulation) -- never promotes to 'complete', which still requires review_checklist. It then calls sync_review_checklist_with_provider_status(), which auto-advances visual_council/music_council/ethics_council from pending to in_review once build_status reaches draft, never regressing a council a human already moved. The worked example's activation is 0.741, wiring in 9 real prompts and advancing 3 of 8 councils.

active_prototypes.name: provider_specific_production_package_schema
active_prototypes.note: First stage with real translation functions (translate_shot_to_video_prompt, translate_musical_architecture_to_music_prompt), not just a validated contract. Includes a dependency-free Monte Carlo generation_risk_estimate (stdlib random, no numpy) whose stored probability must reproduce from its own stated parameters or validation fails -- catches hand-typed/stale numbers. Worked example: Kling AI Avatar + Suno (updated from Runway once the Assembly Package's native_av_policy required a native audio-driven provider for every shot, since all 8 have a singing performer), ~12% probability of exceeding a 14-attempt budget across 8 shots, echoing the source video's own worked example. REQUIRED_INTERFACE_NON_GOAL states no provider rendering is authoritative over the canonical Cinematic/Musical/Editorial documents.

active_prototypes.name: character_performance_package_schema
active_prototypes.note: Answers a direct user request: character-consistent generation (Nano Banana / Gemini 2.5 Flash Image as the character_reference_provider), characters singing themselves instead of a narrator, and -- per explicit follow-up -- a rights-safety gate requiring every character to be original, never a real/existing copyrighted character. no_narrator, lip_sync_required, and original_character are literal hard gates (const true). assess_rights_review_status() rolls per-character resembles_existing_ip_risk flags into a document-level rights_review (clear_to_proceed / hold_for_review), the same flags-to-blockers pattern as apex-rightschain-manifest-builder; the validator reruns it and rejects a stale/hand-typed rights_review, same discipline as the Monte Carlo generation_risk_estimate reproducibility check. A best-effort KNOWN_IP_NAME_BLOCKLIST catches literal franchise-name slip-ups; REQUIRED_RIGHTS_NON_GOAL is explicit that none of this is legal clearance. Cross-checks against Cinematic Architecture (real shot_id references) and the Blueprint's narrative_supplement.character_biographies (every character must be deliberately authored, not silently conjured -- this requires originals, it does not require real ones). Worked example: The Builder and The Asker cover all 8 Hope-chain shots between them, rights_review clear_to_proceed.

active_prototypes.name: assembly_package_schema
active_prototypes.note: Answers a direct user request: get in place what's needed for native audio-driven lip-sync generation plus the post-generation Python work (stitching, reconciling generated clip durations against planned cut durations) that no single provider call can do. native_av_policy.allowed_providers (kling_ai_avatar, runway_act_two, veo3_native_audio) is required data, and validate_native_av_requirement() cross-checks it against the Provider-Specific Production Package's video_prompts[].provider for every shot with a singing performer -- this caught the prior stage's worked example still using silent-video runway and forced the fix to kling_ai_avatar. reconcile_cut_duration() derives a reconciliation_strategy (exact_match / speed_adjust / trim / pad_hold_last_frame / requires_manual_review) deterministically from drift and cut_on_beat, refusing to trim or pad a beat-matched cut (would break the Editorial Architecture's cut-on-beat guarantee) and refusing to auto-resolve drift beyond tolerance at all. render_ffmpeg_command() builds a real, re-derivable ffmpeg filter_complex plan; the validator reruns it and rejects a stale/hand-written command, same reproducibility discipline as generation_risk_estimate and rights_review. Worked example deliberately gives one of 8 cuts a 39% simulated drift so assembly_status lands on blocked_manual_review_required, not a rubber-stamped ready_to_render.

active_prototypes.name: kling_ai_avatar_provider_client
active_prototypes.evidence: 14/14 smoke tests passing via `python3 dreammusicforge/tests/test_kling_ai_avatar_client.py`, all offline via FakeTransport -- no real network call anywhere in this suite
active_prototypes.note: Answers a direct user request to start the live integration layer, scoped to one provider first (Kling AI Avatar, per the agreed native-audio-driven-generation direction). This is the first module in the repository that makes, or is built to make, real network calls -- every schemas/*.py module stays pure validation logic with zero network dependency by design, and that separation is deliberate. build_jwt() is a stdlib-only (hmac/hashlib/base64, no PyJWT) HS256 signer grounded in Kling's publicly documented access-key/secret-key-signed-JWT auth pattern. KlingCredentials.from_env() reads KLING_ACCESS_KEY/KLING_SECRET_KEY and fails closed with no secret value in the error message if either is missing -- no credential is hardcoded or committed anywhere. create_task() takes a real video_prompts[] entry from the Provider-Specific Production Package as-is and rejects an oversized prompt before any request goes out, per Kling's documented 2500-character limit. generate_with_retries() polls to a terminal state and raises GenerationBudgetExceededError rather than fabricating a result if the budget (meant to come from generation_risk_estimate.budget_max_total_attempts, not a separately made-up number) runs out; proven end-to-end against the real Hope-chain shot1 prompt in test_real_shot1_prompt_through_a_scripted_success. Honesty boundary, stated in the module docstring: no API key exists in this environment, so nothing here has been exercised against Kling's real endpoint, and DEFAULT_BASE_URL is an explicitly-flagged unconfirmed placeholder (Kling has both a first-party API and third-party resellers with different paths).

non_goals_now: Do not claim, measure, or optimize for the viewer receiving one intended belief -- the goal is probability of reflection, not compelled comprehension.
Do not build a hard pass/fail comprehension gate against one canonical interpretation (superseded v1 stage 6).
Do not lock the pipeline to a single video or music provider before the translation layer exists.
Do not skip the Principle Engine step -- every project must trace back to one stated timeless principle.
Do not assign a silent-video-only provider to a shot with a singing, lip-synced performer -- native_av_policy.allowed_providers and validate_native_av_requirement() exist specifically to catch that.
Do not silently force a badly-drifted generated clip to fit its planned duration -- reconcile_cut_duration() routes anything past tolerance to requires_manual_review, blocking assembly_status.
Do not hardcode, log, or commit a provider credential anywhere -- KLING_ACCESS_KEY/KLING_SECRET_KEY are read from the environment only.

Do not claim a provider integration is live-verified when it isn't -- the Kling AI Avatar client's request-building and retry logic are fully tested offline, but no real network call has been made from this environment.
